rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when an action is done with much force or effort.

example.english: You need to push hard when you open the door.
example.jyutping: nei5 teoi1 mun4 go2 zan6 jiu3 jung6 lik6 di1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something difficult to do, understand, or deal with.

example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sou3 hok6 tai4 hou2 naan4

rows.note: Use 硬 for physical resistance such as hard food, and in the sexual sense for an erect penis.

example.english: This steak is too hard to chew.
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 ngau4 paa4 taai3 ngaang6 ngaau5 m4 juk1

rows.note: Use this when something is achieved or done with difficulty or strenuous effort.

example.english: I worked hard to finish this report.
example.traditional: 為咗完成呢份報告，我做得好辛苦。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 jyun4 sing4 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 zou6 dak1 hou2 san1 fu2

rows.note: Use 辛苦 for an experience, period, or life that is demanding and difficult to endure.

example.english: Work has been really hard lately.
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 faan1 gung1 zan1 hai6 san1 fu2

rows.note: Use this construction when an object or substance becomes compact and solid all the way through.

example.english: The clay has been kneaded hard all the way through.
example.jyutping: di1 nai4 co1 sat6 saai3 laa3

rows.note: Use 嚴厲 for a person, rule, or manner that is severe or harsh rather than merely difficult.

example.english: The teacher is very hard on students who are late.
example.traditional: 老師對遲到嘅學生好嚴厲。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 deoi3 ci4 dou3 ge3 hok6 saang1 hou2 jim4 lai6
